title: [releases/v0.32.0rc][BugFix][Performance] Zero QSFA TND output tail in-kernel and drop redundant SFA masked_fill
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

cherry pick of https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/20404

**Problem**: On the GLM-5.3-Flash SFA c8 (int8 KV, NoPE, TND layout) path, the fork QSFA kernel (`npu_kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention_vllm`) only writes valid rows of its output buffer. The output is allocated via `at::empty` and the `needInit`-based output initialization excluded TND layouts (plus used a BSND size formula), so
padding rows `[actual, T)` kept stale/NaN residue when graph bucket capacity shrank between calls. The Python side carried a per-layer `masked_fill` workaround (arange + lt + masked_fill × 11 SFA layers per decode step).

**Fix** (ports cann/ops-transformer#14799 to the fork kernel):
- arch32 (A2/A3, 910_93): enable `needInit` for TND and zero only `[actual, T)` read from the device-side cumulative query lengths, with 32B-aligned per-core ranges; full batches skip entirely. The fork's extra softmax-LSE init section is preserved (flag-guarded early skip instead of `return`).
- arch35 (A5): add `InitOutputTail()` hooked into `CleanOutput()` when the full needInit path does not run; no new cross-core barrier (disjoint tail writes, local MTE3_V event guard only).
- Remove the now-redundant Python `masked_fill` in `sfa_v1.py` (NoPE c8 branch).

**Tests**:
- E2E `test_tnd_output_tail_zeroed`: capacity-shrink (128→64) must produce finite valid rows and an exactly-zero tail (fails on the unfixed kernel with NaN tail).
- UT: NoPE c8 path returns the operator buffer unmasked (documents the new contract).

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

NO. Numerics of valid rows are unchanged; only previously-undefined padding rows become defined (zero).

### How was this patch tested?

A3 precision:
 GSM8K 96.89%  AIME26 90.00%

A3 performance:
| Case | BEFORE | AFTER | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2k/512，bs 32 | 257.7 tok/s | 260.2 tok/s | +1.0% |
| 128k/512，bs 8| 12.26 tok/s | 12.44 tok/s | +1.5% |

A5 precision:
GSM8K 97.42%  AIME26 90.00%

A5 performance:
| Case | BEFORE | AFTER | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| prefill 4k | 10.7074 QPS | 10.7624 QPS | +0.5% |
| prefill 128k| 1.494 QPS | 1.5085 QPS | +0.9% |
| decode 4k/2k| 87.3 ITL | 87.0 ITL | +0.3% |
| decode 128k/1k| 121.9 ITL | 113.8 ITL | +6% |
